camel_example: aliyun apig PUT /himarket/v1/portals/portal-xxxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou --clientToken '5f7a2c1e-9b3d-4e8f-a1c6-0d2b8e4f7a13' --header "Content-Type=application/json" --body '{"portalSettingConfig":{"autoApproveSubscriptions":false,"autoApproveDevelopers":false,"builtinAuthEnabled":true},"name":"developer-portal","description":"面向内部开发者的 HiMarket 门户"}'
description_en: Updates the name, description, and portal configurations of a HiMarket developer portal by portal ID. The request body is in JSON format. A successful response returns the ID of the updated portal
description_zh: 按门户 ID 更新该 HiMarket 开发者门户的名称、描述与 Portal 配置，请求体为 JSON，成功响应返回被更新门户的 ID
kebab_example: aliyun apig update-portal --portal-id portal-xxxxxxxx --description '面向内部开发者的 HiMarket 门户' --name developer-portal --portal-setting-config autoApproveSubscriptions=false autoApproveDevelopers=false builtinAuthEnabled=true --client-token 5f7a2c1e-9b3d-4e8f-a1c6-0d2b8e4f7a13 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdatePortal

parameters.help_en: The ID of the portal to update. This is the primary ID of the portal resource. You can obtain the portal ID from the response of the CreatePortal operation or from a portal item in the response of the ListPortals operation. This ID is used in the /himarket/v1/portals/{portalId} path to locate the portal, which is the same path used by the GetPortal, UpdatePortal, and DeletePortal operations
parameters.help_zh: 门户 ID，指定要更新的门户，即门户资源 Portal 的一级 ID（Portal ID）。可由 CreatePortal 响应的 portalId 或 ListPortals 列表项的 portalId 获得，与 GetPortal、UpdatePortal、DeletePortal 使用同一个 /himarket/v1/portals/{portalId} 路径来定位门户
parameters.name: portal_id

parameters.example: 面向内部开发者的 HiMarket 门户
parameters.name: description

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically approve developer registration requests
fields.help_zh: 是否自动审批开发者注册申请
fields.name: auto_approve_developers

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically approve API subscription requests
fields.help_zh: 是否自动审批 API 订阅请求
fields.name: auto_approve_subscriptions

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable username and password authentication (built-in authentication)
fields.help_zh: 是否启用账号密码认证（内置认证）
fields.name: builtin_auth_enabled

parameters.help_en: The portal configurations, including whether to enable username and password authentication, whether to automatically approve developer registrations, and whether to automatically approve subscription requests
parameters.help_zh: Portal 配置信息，包含是否启用账号密码认证、是否自动审批开发者注册、是否自动审批订阅请求
parameters.name: portal_setting_config

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token. The token is generated by the caller and must be unique. It is used to prevent duplicate submissions of the same update request
parameters.help_zh: 幂等令牌。由调用方生成并保证唯一，用于避免同一更新请求被重复提交
parameters.name: client_token

portalId.description_en: The ID of the updated portal. This is the primary ID of the portal resource specified by the portalId path parameter
portalId.description_zh: 门户 ID，即本次更新的门户，对应路径参数 portalId 指定的门户资源 Portal 的一级 ID（Portal ID）
